ALL SHEETS MUST BE COMPLETED IN A TIMELY MANNER FOR CHECK-IN

Please navigate through your coaching sheets using the tabs at the bottom. 

DASHBOARD
- Overview of week/phase, check-in, nutrition, expenditure and competition setup.
- You DO NOT need to do anything with this, it works automatically.

DAILY TRACKER
- Complete the dated week shown on the DASHBOARD.
- Log bodyweight, sleep, activity, training, biofeedback, biometrics and nutrition.
- Daily inputs go here; weekly averages calculate automatically.

TIMELINE
- You DO NOT need to do anything with this, it works automatically.

MEALPLAN
- Here you will find your meal plan. 

SUPPLEMENTATION
- Here you will find your supplementation. 

MENSES
- Automatic cycle dashboard; log cycle data in DAILY TRACKER.
- Review cycle day/phase, cycle length, period/ovulation estimates, previous cycles and BBT.

TRAINING
- Follow the scheduled day/split; exercise order and names are pre-filled.
- EXERCISE DATABASE is reference only; record load, reps and notes for each working set.

PEAKING
- Use this tab when peaking for a show begins.
- Complete setup, check-in, AM/PM weight, water/salt, activity/cardio, training and nutrition.
- If water or salt is not prescribed, record actual intake.

SHOWDAY
- Review show details and add the day’s timings/instructions; use NOTES for details.

SALT/WATER TRACKER
- You can use that as a tool to track your daily intake by just putting in the correct values.
